core_claims.claim: OS Terrain 50 is an open lower-resolution DTM product.
Grid posts use regular 50m spacing.
Standard contours use 10m intervals.
Grid and contour data use the same source data.
Supply tiles are 10km by 10km.
Tile identity uses the National Grid reference of the southwest corner.
Grid formats include ASCII grid.
Grid formats include GML 3.2.1 simple features level 0.
Contour formats include GML 3.2.1.
Contour formats include Esri shapefile.
Contour formats include GeoPackage.
Contour formats include vector tiles in MBTiles.
Contour feature types include ContourLine.
Contour feature types include SpotHeight.
Contour feature types include LandWaterBoundary.
Spot-height z values are rounded to zero decimal places.
Spot heights are selected automatically from enclosed contours.
A spot height can be below its enclosing contour in genuine depressions.
GML features and geometries require unique identifiers.
Terrain 50 feature identifiers include product tile and sequence.
Whole-tile refresh regenerates sequential feature identifiers.
Terrain 50 GML uses EPSG 27700 in a URN.
Per-tile XML metadata follows GEMINI.
Per-tile metadata records tile reference and spatial representation.
Vector tiles use Web Mercator EPSG 3857.
Vector contour attributes become available from zoom level 9.
Grid pixels are calculated at pixel centres.
Adjacent grid tiles do not share common edge values.
Exact TQ29 binary bytes and target cells remain unread.
Tile documentation cannot substitute for candidate-specific measured cells.
